newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume up, prices mixed.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume up, prices mixed.

text.p: Volume rose and prices were mixed on the Istanbul gold exchange on Thursday as liquidity in the money markets boosted demand, dealers said.

Traded volume jumped to 697 kilos from just 130 kilos on Wednesday. Gold closed at $369.25 an ounce, down from a previous $370.00, and at 1,238,300 lira per gram, up slightly from Wednesday's 1,238,000.
"Lower overnight rates produced a cash liquidity which, with the stabilisation of gold prices on world markets, encouraged buyers to enter the market," one dealer said.
Dealers said a weak lira caused gold prices to edge higher in lira terms.
The lira closed at 104,160 against the dollar after Wednesday's 103,900 due to the dollar's gains against the mark in world markets.
Turnover was 492 kilos in the morning session, and 76 percent of all business was in lira.
